The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The verifier failed in test_derived_values_and_stats at /tests/test_outputs.py:155. Multiple cells (H46:L47) returned '#NAME?' instead of expected numeric values like -14.74 or 16.13. This typically indicates a typo in a formula name, a missing named range, or an unsupported Excel function in the openpyxl/workbook generation logic. While the 'net metric' matrix passed, the 'statistics' matrix assertion failed with a list of mismatches.
